decisions: The pinned Drawer wrapper owns the actual parts and primitive lifecycle; Root/Portal are controllers rather than invented DOM identities. The edge surface follows actual swipeDirection values; horizontal edge surfaces cap at the selected native 384px width, vertical edge surfaces span the available viewport. Header inset 16px/gap 2px and footer inset 20px/gap 8px retain native section metrics. Native title 16/24 (Medium, or Semi Bold for AlertDialog) and body 14/20 are intrinsic text roles, never fixed frame heights. Footer order remains DOM order and wraps. Button actions explicitly depend on Button tokens/CVA, while primitive triggers remain bare unless the caller composes Button. Backdrop 50% and viewport clearance are explicit reference decisions; static examples do not measure live dimming. Close and Escape follow the actual primitive callback and host authority; no CSS rule invents state transitions. The pinned Drawer motion utilities bind the documented live primitive swipe, measured height, snap offset and nested-stack variables. These are real runtime inputs, not DTCG observations. Upstream 450ms easing,400ms release scalar,16px stack peek,0.05 scale step and 96px vertical clearance are explicit source-code decisions. Reduced motion disables transitions without disabling gestures or closing. All lifecycle attributes remain primitive output, never new public state props.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
